display_long_description:
Car Paint Simulator puts you in a bright, spacious paint booth with a car parked over the floor grate and a table full of real painting tools behind you.

THE PAINT BOOTH
A filter ceiling, LED wall lights, a floor grate and folding glass doors. Grab a spray gun, an airless sprayer, a spray can, a roller or a brush and paint lands exactly where you aim, on the doors, hood, roof, bumpers and spoiler.

THE COLOUR WHEEL
Press X and a wheel of colours opens in front of you. Point, pull the trigger, and your tools are loaded with that colour. Paint two-tone, fades, stripes or one solid coat.

NINE CARS
A sports car, sedan, hatchback, compact, wagon, minivan, SUV, pickup and off-roader. Press the NEXT CAR post and the doors open, your car drives out into the lot and the next car drives in.

THE MECHANIC SHOP
Walk through the shop door into a big mechanic shop. The car you are painting sits on a two-post lift: press the button to raise it and walk underneath. The last cars you painted are parked in the bays, still wearing your paint.

MENU AND MUSIC
The MENU button opens next car, reset paint, travel between booth and shop, and nine music tracks.

FEATURES
- Spray guns, an airless sprayer, a spray can, rollers and brushes
- A colour wheel picked with a laser
- Nine paintable cars that drive in and out of the booth
- A mechanic shop with a working lift and parking bays
- Reset paint any time, nine music tracks
- Walk with the left stick, snap turn with the right
